name: Logistics Insight Corp - Stellantis Sequencing Plant - Detroit MI (Georgia St)

fieldNotes.facility: Large (~1,000,000 sq ft) Universal/LINC parts-sequencing & sub-assembly campus at 6836 Georgia St on Detroit's east side, sequencing/sub-assembling ~114 components for Jeep Grand Cherokees at the Stellantis Mack Avenue assembly plant. Crown Enterprises (Moroun-family) nearly doubled the building; Teamsters Local 299. NOTE: WARN-noticed for closure beginning Feb 2025 with ~677 layoffs (Stellantis reportedly moving the work to a lower-cost operator) — operational status uncertain as of 2026. Building positively identified via Crain's Detroit / MoparInsiders and 2023 Street View showing Universal/ULC-branded trailers behind a fenced yard.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole site is fully fenced — 2023 Street View along Georgia St and the SE/SW corners shows continuous chain-link perimeter fence with trailers parked behind it. Truck access through the fence is gated but no barrier arm resolves cleanly in imagery; classified as a controlled gate. Two probable gate openings (SW corner near the rail crossing and the north internal-road junction) -> truckGateCount estimated 2.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth (1-3 vehicle footprint) resolvable at any gate. For a JIT auto-sequencing site access is most likely badge/kiosk controlled -> remoteGs true. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dense loading-dock banks on BOTH the north and south long faces of the main building (trailers backed in continuously) -> a true cross-dock sequencing layout, ~150+ doors total -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts and outbound sequenced/sub-assembled modules run from physically separate north-face and south-face dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple large trailer-parking yards across the campus (north/NW gravel lots full of parked trailers, plus an SE drop lot) -> 50+ band; dedicated drop yards.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus is multi-parcel: the main ~1M sq ft sequencing building plus an older secondary building cluster to the west and several distinct satellite trailer-storage yards.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight urban site hemmed by public streets and an adjacent residential neighborhood on the south; a truck queue at a gate would quickly spill onto the public street with little stacking room.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the west edge of the campus with old/abandoned spurs but no live spur servicing the building -> railServed false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~58 acres for the main fenced operation including the immediate trailer yards.
